description: This file defines the ICacheDataAdapter interface in the Orleans.Streaming.Common namespace, which provides methods for transforming cached messages into batch containers and extracting sequence tokens.

classes.name: ICacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Interface for adapters that transform cached queue data into various formats and extract stream sequence tokens.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a cached message to a batch container suitable for delivery.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stream sequence token from a cached message.
